faq.title: A few questions of your own?
faq.q1: Do I need to know how to code?
faq.a1: No. Use the editor to create and organize questions, customize the design and publish your form.
faq.a2: Yes. Adjust colors, text and welcome and completion pages to create an experience that reflects your identity.
faq.q3: How do I share forms and see responses?
faq.a3: Publish your form and share its link. Responses are available in your dashboard.
faq.a4: Yes. Explore the code on GitHub or host your own instance following the documentation and license terms.
